title: Introduce ingest-guardian and compact-change summarizer
author: Diego Lopez
description:
Motivation: onboarding noisy third-party model manifests revealed two recurring issues: (1) missing/ambiguous variant metadata that causes downstream profile generation to emit unstable diffs, and (2) release notes that are too verbose for daily ingestion bursts. This PR adds a small guardian service that validates and normalizes incoming model manifests against a stricter ingestion schema, attaches a stability hint set, and emits a compact change summary suitable for quick release briefs. The goal is to reduce churn in release automation and make profile signing deterministic for stable variants.

What this changes (high level):
- registry/ingest/guardian.py: new lightweight guardian that enforces schema v2 and normalizes fields (aliases, architecture hints, supported-sequences).
- registry/ingest/schema/v2.yaml: explicit ingestion schema with stable-key rules and defaulting logic.
- registry/handlers/signing.py: extend signing path to accept guardian-stamped manifests and produce deterministic profile signatures.
- registry/pipelines/compact_summary.py: pipeline component that generates a 2-3 line compact change summary for release briefs (works off diff tokens + impact heuristics).
- tests/ingest/test_guardian.py: unit coverage for normalization and error paths.
- docs/model-intake/quickstart.md: docs for partners and internal SDK usage notes.
- tools/release/brief_templates.yaml: small templates for release automation to pick up compact summaries.
- ci/workflows/model-registry.yml: added a guardian smoke test to the model-registry CI matrix.

Design notes:
- Determinism: normalizer sorts variant lists, canonicalizes names, and strips ephemeral keys before signing. This produces stable signatures across equivalent manifests.
- Backwards compatibility: guardian is opt-in for existing ingestion flows; we enable it by default for new automated intake pipelines. A migration tool is provided (scripts/migrate_guardian.sh referenced in docs) to stamp existing manifests in batch.
- Compact summary: picks the top-2 changed capabilities, one sentence on expected user-facing impact, and a short cost/latency delta when available. Intended for daily release digests and the console brief.

Testing and rollout: unit tests added, integration smoke in CI, and a canary gate that stamps 10% of new uploads behind a feature flag for 48h. After metrics stabilize we will flip the default to 100%.

(2) Integrate signing and compact-summary pipeline (diego/signing-summary) — extend signer and register pipeline. (3) Docs and CI tweaks (diego/docs-ci) — quickstart and CI smoke test. Each commit includes small helper functions and license headers.

review_thread:
Maya Chen: 'Thanks — this addresses a lot of the churn we've seen. Two asks: (1) add a non-destructive dry-run mode to the guardian for initial stamping; (2) make the canonicalization rules pluggable via a small registry config.'

Diego: 'Added dry-run flag, default off; documented in quickstart. Pluggable normalizers via registry/ingest/schema/v2.yaml comments and a NormalizerRegistry interface — implementation uses a default chain but supports plugin loading. Updated tests.'

Ethan Brooks: 'Can you add an integration test that signs a previously ingested manifest and verifies signature stability after normalization?'

Diego: 'Added test_guardian::test_signature_stability in tests/ingest/test_guardian.py to exercise the signing handshake and compare signatures across shuffled input.'

Sofia Patel: 'Docs look good. One nit: brief template should include a fallback when cost delta is unknown.'

Diego: 'Added fallback text and a small unit in compact_summary to render "cost delta: unknown" when metrics missing.'

Approvals: Maya Chen approved after dry-run addition; Ethan requested small tidy which was applied and signoff given. Final approval by Maya and Sofia. CI green on last run.'
merge_outcome: merged (squash) by Maya Chen — merge commit message: 'Introduce ingest guardian and compact change summarizer — deterministic signing and compact release briefs' — changelog entry generated by release tooling and included in the merge message.
release_notes:
- Introduce ingest-guardian: validates and normalizes model manifests for deterministic profile signing.
- Add compact change summarizer for concise release briefs (2–3 lines).
- Opt-in canary enabled for 10% of automations; migration guide added to docs/model-intake/quickstart.md.
